fixed_features.feature: Square numeric matrix, direct classification, one five-label radio field
fixed_features.justification: All source prompts ask best description; lesson defines upper/lower only for square matrices.

fixed_features.feature: At least half the permitted triangle must be nonzero
fixed_features.justification: Author claims scan workload, but this excludes the canonical one-witness matrix and the lesson explicitly permits any number including zero on the permitted side. This constraint fails independent review.

coverage.result: All five survive: two upper, two lower, one diagonal, four 3x3 and one 2x2. No demonstrated batch-wide answer shortcut; small conditional groups underpowered.

counterfactuals.change: Hold diagonal, size, letter and seed fixed; transpose base strict lower, then clear its off-diagonal entries.
counterfactuals.expected: Lower becomes upper on transpose and diagonal on clearing; prompts, solutions and native choices follow.
counterfactuals.observed: Independent exact prompt/solution checks, all five native choices per record, and actual UI rendering establish the expected three responses.
counterfactuals.justification: Directly changes the zero-side evidence that determines the description.

counterfactuals.change: Keep support fixed and change nonzero signs and diagonal values only.
counterfactuals.expected: Lower classification preserved, with new entries in prompt and explanation.
counterfactuals.observed: Lower response preserved; native grader accepts lower and rejects all other labels; UI and repeated matrix checked.
counterfactuals.justification: Lesson explicitly permits any diagonal values and permitted-side values; nonzero signs do not decide triangularity.
